## Audience

 Digital entrepreneurs and creators seeking a tool to sell, host, and scale their online products and services

## About FanBasis

 FanBasis is an all-in-one software platform designed to run high-ticket, high-margin digital businesses, providing everything from checkout to fulfillment with built-in financing, premium payments, and enterprise-grade scale. It offers features such as crypto payments, automated fulfillment, order bumps, upsells, custom dashboards, integration with over seven Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) providers, shareable payment links, flexible financing, and customizable checkout funnels. FanBasis enables users to unlock end-to-end growth tools—from hosting products to processing payments, all in one powerful platform. It ensures secure payment acceptance with reliable payouts for users and affiliates, backed by infrastructure built to protect revenue at every step. It supports scaling through real-time dashboards, embedded BNPL, dedicated automation, and growth specialists.

Other Popular Alternatives & Related Software

 Chargezoom

Unlock the power of your payments to accelerate growth. Fully Integrated Payments, Easy as 1-2-3. One-click integration connects most major accounting packages with your existing payment gateway. In less than 5 minutes payments will automatically reconcile in real-time, saving hours of effort daily. Chargezoom's integrated payment solution works with over 20 popular payment gateways; nothing to change, no transaction fees, just point, click and integrate! Two-Way Sync Payment Dashboard eInvoicing / Pay by email Compliant Surcharging Subscription Management Tokenized Customer Vault Developer-First API Building your payments infrastructure has never been so easy!

[Learn more about Chargezoom](https://sourceforge.net/software/product/Chargezoom/)

 Exact Payments

Exact Payments develops and delivers easy-to-integrate and highly scalable payments technology for SaaS companies to seamlessly embed payment flows into their software and activate a new, high-margin revenue stream. With Exact’s PayFac-as-a-Service solution, SaaS providers build frictionless buying journeys that enhance customer experience, improve retention, and increase the lifetime value of a customer by as much as 5x. Today, Exact processes nearly 1 billion transactions annually for prominent customers, including Chase, Ordway, Cineplex, Allianz, Levi’s, and Carfax. Exact is integrated with leading processors in the US and Canada, including Elavon, Fiserv, Global Payments/TSYS, Chase Canada, and Moneris. Our payment solutions are designed for performance and reliability, supporting over 10,000 merchant clients and delivering 99.99% uptime availability with transaction response times of less than 1 second.

[Learn more about Exact Payments](https://sourceforge.net/software/product/Exact-Payments/)

 Mollie

Mollie is a money management platform that powers growth for over 250,000 businesses – from startups to enterprises. It's a single platform to get paid and simplify your finances, with online and in-person payments, subscriptions, financing, reconciliation, invoicing, and fraud prevention tools. Get started in minutes with transparent pricing, no hidden fees, and no lock-in contract.

[Learn more about Mollie](https://sourceforge.net/software/product/Mollie/)

 Cleverbridge

A configurable platform that has everything you need to sell online; around the world. Additionally, our expert growth services make sure you have all the tools to hit revenue targets and ensure customer satisfaction, where ever, whenever. Sell your products and services around the world, focusing on your core business. In the background, we will navigate international taxation and compliance, ensure localized checkout experiences, manage fraud and everything else, enabling you with a host of best-in-class solutions. Take charge of complicated pricing, billing and payment processing no matter the situation with easy-to-use, adaptable solutions for B2B and B2C. B2B users expect an experience that at least equals their day-to-day digital lives. Our solutions leverage 15 years of eCommerce experience to fit the needs of B2B clients and their customers.

[Learn more about Cleverbridge](https://sourceforge.net/software/product/Cleverbridge/)

## FanBasis Frequently Asked Questions

 Q: What kinds of users and organization types does FanBasis work with?
 FanBasis works with these users and organization types: Mid Size Business, Small Business, Enterprise, Freelance, Nonprofit, Government, and Startup.

 Q: What languages does FanBasis support in their product?
 FanBasis supports these languages: English.

 Q: What kind of support options does FanBasis offer?
 FanBasis offers support via online.

 Q: What other applications or services does FanBasis integrate with?
 FanBasis integrates with: Airtable, American Express Go, Apple Pay, Google Cloud BigQuery, Close, Docusign, Google Analytics, Google Pay, Google Sheets, GoHighLevel, HubSpot CRM, Looker, QuickBooks Online, Slack, Thinkific, and Xero.

 Q: Does FanBasis have a mobile app?
 Yes, FanBasis has a mobile app for iPhone and iPad.

 Q: What type of training does FanBasis provide?
 FanBasis provides training in the form of documentation and live online.

 Q: How much does FanBasis cost?
 Pricing for FanBasis starts at Free.
